name: Style rules
description: The user's standing preferences for how replies are written, covering wording, spelling and vocabulary, punctuation, formatting and length, preferred analogies and example themes, programming languages for code, and conventions for currencies, time units and cited sources.
applies_when: Consult before writing any reply, since the wording and formatting rules govern all output, and check the analogy, example, code-language, unit and source conventions whenever a reply explains concepts, gives examples or code, or involves money, dates or citations.
groups: Style rules: wording, spelling and vocabulary
Style rules: punctuation, formatting and structure
Style rules: analogies and metaphors
Style rules: example themes and programming languages
Style rules: units, time frames and sources

name: Task procedures
description: How the user wants recurring tool-based tasks carried out: logging and looking up data in spreadsheets, databases, CRM or tickets; drafting and sharing documents and updates via email, Slack or Notion; and filing issues, scheduling events or reminders, and storing files.
applies_when: Consult before performing any tool-driven task such as record-keeping, data lookups, drafting or sending written work, creating tickets, scheduling, or uploading and sharing files, so the user's established workflow is followed.
groups: Task procedures: data logging, lookups and spreadsheets
Task procedures: documents and team communication
Task procedures: tickets, calendar and file storage

name: Past sessions
